name: Akuji
source:
Akuji is one of the main love interests and Leah's boyfriend. He's a small-time actor in his twenties who mainly stars in theatre. Almost the complete opposite of Leah, Akuji is an extrovert who views the world through rose-tinted glasses, always optimistic and full of energy. He's a cheeky soul who adores Leah with all of his heart.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/apartment-no9]itch.io[/url]]
